scope.population: 2,480,267 fills, 45,849 taker and 9,367 maker pseudonyms; every row of the two aligned intermediates, reduced to the columns the notebook consumes

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

object: Reduced review dataset for the reproducibility notebook, with pseudonymous wallet codes
author: Dmitry Stakhin
deidentified: taker_code and maker_code are pseudonyms, re-indexed contiguous integers; the hex address map is not shipped, so the linkage to on-chain addresses is not distributed here, but a reader holding the public source data can re-derive it, because the Hyperliquid node data the fills were built from, and the open deposit of the same trades by Albers et al. (Zenodo 18184441), carry the same fills with their addresses

published.note: in no current archive record. The notebook reads notebook_fills.npz and notebook_book_{COIN}.npz from record 23540388 and never opens this file

superseded_copy.why: written before i4_midmarkout.join_entry stopped accepting a book snapshot stamped at the fill's own millisecond, on 2026-08-02. Its six book-side columns carry the retired values and its pooled 10 s book-mid markout is +2.0616 bps, the figure that correction retired
